BiblicalUsage: Shimath is the Ammonitess mother of Jozachar, who with Jehozabad slew King Joash. Her name is given in both the Kings and the Chronicles accounts of the murder.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mother's name is given because the murder had a home behind it, and an Ammonitess in the king's house is part of the story. I hold that Joash's end began long before the sword, when foreign wives came into the palace.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
